verdict.rationale: CSC documents same-day scanning, OCR, and time-stamped electronic delivery of service-of-process documents as searchable PDFs. It also routes them to designated contacts, and its CSCNavigator dashboard gives 24x7 online access to filed documents linked to each entity. missing for 10: explicit coverage of general state mail beyond SOP and filed evidence, documented in-portal download and share controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
